1. Threshold Adjustments.description: Lowered various detection thresholds to be more aggressive
changes: Pure neural threshold for high-sensitivity categories: 0.72 → 0.68 → 0.60
Pure neural threshold for severe content: 0.70 → 0.65 → 0.60
1. Threshold Adjustments.rationale: Lower thresholds catch more adversarial prompts that neural model scores are marginal on

2. Keyword-Based Detection.description: Added rule-based keyword detection to complement neural layer
changes: Added jailbreak keyword detection (roleplay, unfiltered, without policy)
Added prompt injection keyword detection ([SYSTEM], [ADMIN], higher priority)
Added harmful content keyword detection (malware, ransomware, botnet, ddos, payloads)
Keyword scores combined with neural scores for hybrid detection
Keyword detection generates scores 0.15-0.85 depending on pattern density
2. Keyword-Based Detection.rationale: Neural models sometimes miss attack patterns that are obvious via keywords

3. Direct Pattern-Based Blocking.description: Added blocking rules that trigger on specific attack patterns

detection_rules.trigger: Presence of injection markers ([SYSTEM], higher priority, etc)
Presence of harmful keywords (malware, botnet, ddos, payload)

4. Keyword Boosting.description: Neural scores are enhanced with keyword detection signals
4. Keyword Boosting.boosting_logic: If keyword score > 0.2, use max(neural_score, keyword_score)
4. Keyword Boosting.expected_effect: Pulls weak/marginal neural signals above blocking threshold
